blocks.text: It’s been almost a year since the last Desktop Pet update. Here’s what has been happening behind the scenes.
Earlier this year I landed a new job in the tech industry! It has been exciting, but learning a new role kept me busy, so I had less time for Desktop Pet than I wanted.
I never forgot about this little project. I was surprised to see people still subscribing and waiting for updates, and that motivated me to pick up where I left off.
I’ve been working on making Desktop Pet easier to use, more customizable, and even smarter!
Here’s what’s included in the latest update:

items.title: Simplified Windows Installation
items.text: No more extracting ZIP files! Desktop Pet now offers a more straightforward installation process for Windows users, making it easier to get started.

items.title: Uninstall Directly from the App
items.text: You can now uninstall Desktop Pet directly from within the application. The uninstall process removes the app from your computer, including its files in the original download location.
items.note: Important: Uninstalling Desktop Pet also permanently deletes your account information, saved settings, and previously granted permissions. If you reinstall the app later, you’ll need to set everything up again.

items.title: Day & Night Themes
items.text: Menus and dialogs now support light and dark appearances for a more comfortable experience.

items.title: Improved AI Assistant
items.text: I’ve made improvements to the AI assistant to enhance your experience interacting with your desktop companion.

items.title: More AI Providers
items.text: Alongside the existing OpenAI integration, Desktop Pet now also supports Claude and Grok, giving you more flexibility to choose your preferred AI provider.

blocks.text: And this time, I don’t plan on disappearing for another year!
I’m committed to ongoing development and more regular updates. I can’t promise a fixed release schedule yet, but I’ll keep you posted on new features and what’s coming next.
I’d love your feedback! Found an issue, have an idea, or want a feature? Send a note from the site.
Thank you for sticking around and supporting Desktop Pet. There’s more to come!
